item.title: Virat Kohli set to play Delhi’s Vijay Hazare Trophy matches at Chinnaswamy Stadium: Report
item.description: In a major development, Indian batting stalwart Virat Kohli might play Delhi's Vijay Hazare Trophy fixtures at his IPL home ground – M Chinnaswamy Stadium. While the Delhi District Cricket Association (DDCA) has confirmed Kohli's participation in the domestic one-day tournament, the Chinnaswamy stadium has received Karnataka government's clearance to stage competitive matches for the first time after the stampede tragedy following RCB’s maiden IPL title win earlier this year. item.title: WATCH: Virat Kohli returns to Mumbai from London, fuels speculation about his possible meeting with Lionel Messi
item.description: Legendary India batter Virat Kohli on Saturday (December 13) touched down the country, 11 days ahead of his reported participation in the Vijay Hazare Trophy for Delhi. His return to London is creating a buzz among fans as they are speculating the star cricketer’s possible meet and greet with football icon Lionel Messi, who is in India for 'GOAT tour', a series of promotional events in Kolkata, Mumbai, Delhi and Hyderabad. item.title: IND v SA 2025: “I am up for batting at 3, 4, 5 or 6,” Tilak Varma explains team management's push for flexible order
item.description: On the eve of third T20I against South Africa in Dharamsala, India batter Tilak Varma addressed a press conference, where he emphasized the team management's push for a flexible batting order, saying most players are ready to bat anywhere depending on match situations. The hosts aim to gain a lead in the five-T20I series, currently locked 1-1 after first two games in Cuttack and New Chandigarh. item.title: PCB unhappy with ICC over Pakistan captain Salman Ali Agha’s absence from T20 World Cup ticket poster
item.description: The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has expressed displeasure with the International Cricket Council (ICC) over the omission of its national captain Salman Ali Agha from the promotional poster for the upcoming T20 World Cup ticket sales, which only included five captains from other teams. item.title: Ashes 2025-26: WATCH - England's security staff clashes with Australian media ahead of third Test
item.description: The Ashes rivalry has spiced up off the the field as England team security clashed with Australian media at Brisbane Airport on Saturday (December 13). The incident added another layer of drama to England’s already difficult Ashes campaign. Having lost the first two Tests at Perth and Gabba, the Ben Stokes-led side is trailing 0-2 in the five-match series. item.title: IND v SA 2025: “It's a massive fall,” Sanjay Bangar’s take on Suryakumar Yadav's T20I struggles lately
item.description: While Suryakumar Yadav has managed to produce impressive results as India’s T20I captain, his output with the bat has gone down considerably ever since assuming the leadership role. Suryakumar’s form in 2025 has been far from convincing. He has managed to score only 201 runs across 19 matches and 17 innings, averaging less than 15, with the best score of 47* to his credit. item.title: Ashes 2025-26: “I'm ready to go,” Usman Khawaja declares himself fit ahead of Adelaide Test
item.description: Left-handed opener Usman Khawaja is confident of finding a place in Australia’s XI amid a debate growing over his exclusion for the third Ashes Test, slated to begin on December 17 at the Adelaide Oval. Although the southpaw has expressed readiness for the fixture by declaring himself ‘100 percent fit', his selection in the playing XI remains uncertain. item.title: WATCH: “I am feeling so proud,” Nitish Kumar Reddy shares his feelings after claiming a hat-trick in SMAT

item.title: “Gave us a lot of exposure,” Mohammad Nabi acknowledges BCCI, Indian government’s support for Afghanistan cricket

item.title: IND v SA 2025: “We have idea of what our World Cup squad will be,” Proteas coach defends constant changes in T20I XI
item.description: Ahead of the third T20I against India in Dharamsala, South Africa head coach Shukri Conrad said that their T20 World Cup 2026 preparation focuses on managing players’ workload rather than roles. Conrad also made it clear that the selectors and team management are ‘pretty clear’ about their lineup for the global showpiece.
